title: allantodia calogramma
intro: Allantodia calogramma, commonly known as the Chinese fern or maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant that has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues.
